Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) vulnerability. User input from request.GET['fragment'] is concatenated into a Jinja2 template and rendered, allowing arbitrary code execution.
NoSQL Injection vulnerability. User-controlled JSON payload is passed directly to MongoDB find_one() query, allowing attackers to inject arbitrary query operators.

extra.message: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability. User input from request.GET['copyline'] is directly concatenated into an HTML response without sanitization or escaping.
